title: Zau Li Waung

page_data.en:
D. I. D.
F. O. REG
No. 248
Date 12/4/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

April 12th 1916

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
Zau Li Waung 趙連璜 a staff officer to General Yang who is said to be assisting the rebels, has been sent to Pootung.
It is reported that the rebels are trying to make arrangements to have General Yang and Zee Kou Liang 褚輔成 Chief of Police assassinated by their subordinates.
Five hundred troops left on the 10th instant and six hundred left on 11th instant by train for the north. They boarded the train on Markham Road siding.
Extraordinary precautions were taken in Chapel last night, four machine guns being placed outside the Central Police Station.
It is reported that the Arsenal Authorities have placed mines in the river. It is hoped that by means of these mines it will be possible to blow up the warships should they assist the rebels.
The Central Government has instructed General Yang to approach the Consular Body with a view to extraditing an ex-official named Dong Zau Tsoong 唐在莊 who is said to be hiding in Shanghai. Dong is wanted for absconding from his post.
It is reported that eight more of the soldiers who took part in the attempted mutiny at Woo Ching Ying 滬軍營 Camp were shot at the Arsenal on the afternoon of 11th instant.
It is reported that Chekiang will declare independence today. Enquiries at the Shanghai Hangchow-Nanking Railway (South Station) go to show that the employees there have instructions to run trains only as far as Sungkiang today and until they receive further orders.
Seven soldiers deserted from the Arsenal on 11th instant with full equipment.

Your Obedient Servant,
J Wham Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（左侧批注：）
Entered on
M. S. Apr. 12
Seen by C.S.P.
Copy sent to
S. Y. C.

D. I. D.
F. O. REG
第 248 号
日期 1916年4月12日

上海工部局。

1916年4月12日

（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股。）

先生：

据称协助叛军的杨将军的参谋赵连璜（Zau Li Waung）已被派往浦东。

据悉，叛军正试图安排由其部下刺杀杨将军及警察局长褚辅成（Zee Kou Liang）。

五百名士兵于本月10日乘火车北上，六百名士兵于11日乘火车北上。他们在马克姆路（Markham Road）侧线登上火车。

昨晚在礼拜堂（Chapel）采取了特别预防措施，四挺机枪被部署在中央巡捕房外。

据悉，兵工厂当局已在河中布设水雷。希望借助这些水雷，能够在战舰协助叛军时将其炸毁。

中央政府已指示杨将军与领事团接洽，以期引渡一名名为唐在莊（Dong Zau Tsoong）的前官员，据称此人藏匿于上海。唐因擅离职守而被通缉。

据悉，另有八名参与沪军营（Woo Ching Ying Camp）未遂兵变的士兵，于本月11日下午在兵工厂被枪决。

据悉，浙江将于今日宣布独立。对上海杭宁铁路（南站）的查询显示，该处员工接获指令，今日列车仅运行至松江，直至收到进一步命令为止。

本月11日，七名士兵携带全套装备从兵工厂开小差逃跑。

您顺从的仆人，
J Wham Armstrong
总探长

警务处总监

（左侧批注：）
录入于
M. S. 4月12日
警务处总监阅
副本发送至
S. Y. C.
Cm
